scope: Installed official Vercel CLI64.7.0 / Blob SDK2.8.0 source only; no auth/env values opened, no API/store requests, minting, rotation, connection or env writes.

sensitiveValueBoundary.redactedBlankMeans: UNKNOWN/withheld, not proof that Production is unset.
sensitiveValueBoundary.publicFallbackForbiddenForPrivateBackup: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN; source public-media credential path only; distinct store binding must never be replaced.

acceptedInputs: Existing explicit oidc-token paired with store-id.
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN in process or .env.local as generic SDK RW input; unsuitable if it points to public store.
cliDataAuthorization.linkedProject: Help mentions project linkage, but this implemented getBlobRWToken resolver only reads existing flags/env/.env.local. No account-to-Blob data delegation call occurs there.
cliDataAuthorization.listAndGet: Forward token or oidcToken/storeId to Blob SDK; no additional native account token exchange.

metadata.scope: CLI account auth/team context, metadata only; no data-authorization conclusion.

headers.authorization: Bearer existing RW or signed OIDC token (never the CLI account token by inference).

list.response: Inventory metadata; raw list may reveal private paths and must remain private or be projected to counts/hashes.

notes: SDK constructs URL from normalized explicit store ID for a pathname.
Content get sends direct Bearer; no separate token exchange and no x-store header.
CLI get without --output streams content to stdout; do not use this for private bytes in visible logs.
Future controlled helper must pin exact private origin, consume/hash streams with bounds and avoid redirects/SDK retry ambiguity as separately reviewed.

signedDelegation.classification: New secret issuance, not readonly account fallback; no list operation in delegated operations. Not executed or authorized by this research.

explicitProjectOidc.scope: Token issuance using account Bearer; source provides no target/environment request field or production-claim guarantee. Not executed.

projectEnvPull.sourceProof: pull() defaultsource vercel-cli:env:pull, explicit parseTarget environment; pullEnvRecords adds target path for project ID.
projectEnvPull.consumedField: response.env for project pull; response.buildEnv for deployment pull.
projectEnvPull.oidcHandling: records.VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN copied unchanged by CLI; no local signing, rewriting, JWT environment verification or Production guarantee.
projectEnvPull.actualClaims: UNKNOWN until a trusted native response is inspected privately. Requested Production environment alone does not establish OIDC environment=production.
oneSafeRootProjection: Whitelisted decoded metadata issuer/audience/project/owner/environment/sub/iat/exp, with no token, signature, raw payload, jti or credential-derived hash.
Decoded metadata alone is not independent cryptographic signature verification; do not relabel a development token as production or loosen Blob/store environment policy.
Confirm exact same CRM project/team and existing private store connection/allowed environment before any later Blob read.
Keep sensitive blanks withheld; no fallback to public-store credential.

legacyStorePermission.required: Existing store-to-project binding and server-enforced OIDC environment permission; no support guarantee from store ID or generic CLI login.
legacyStorePermission.sdkEvidence: Blob SDK has explicit oidc_environment_not_allowed error handling; data API enforces policy.
